messages:
ava: Heads-up  cloud marketplace inventory and hardware partner manifest disagree. We have a double-allocation risk on the July reserved pool.
mike: Oof. Which reservations?
supply-bot: Sync alert: reservations [RC-20001, RC-20002, RC-20003] showed 420 units reserved. Marketplace ledger shows 340 available for our commit window. Discrepancy: 80 GPUs marked 'pending-ship' vs 'allocated'.
zoe: Can you dump the manifest mapping?
supply-bot: Quick map:
```
RC-20001 -> PartnerX allocation 160 (customer contracts: NovaPay 120)
RC-20002 -> Marketplace commit 140 (public SKU pool)
RC-20003 -> Internal buffer 120
Total manifest 420
Marketplace visible 340 -> missing 80
```
carlos: That 80 shortfall is likely a cross-listing issue with PartnerX's staging warehouse. They may have reserved those units for a different buyer in their system.
mike: If PartnerX already booked them elsewhere, we risk missing NovaPay's launch SLA on 2026-07-05. We need options: (1) get PartnerX to reassign, (2) airfreight 80 from partner hub, (3) marketplace burst + cross-region swap.
ava: Legal/ops priorities: avoid SLA credit. @legal what do we say externally?
legal: Don't admit fault. External language: "We're validating a supplier inventory update and enacting mitigations to maintain your launch schedule. We'll update within 4 hours." Avoid numbers.
ops-bot: Ops suggestions: a) Check PartnerX's warehouse hold flags (ETA 1h). b) Query cross-region pool eu-central for 60 spare units (transfer ops ~24h). c) Temporary marketplace burst for up to 80 units (cost premium).
zoe: I'll ping PartnerX account and request an immediate inventory reconciliation and release of any holds. Also ask for Bills of Lading.
mike: If PartnerX can free 50 of the 80 within 24h we can combine with 30 from eu-central and avoid expensive bursting.
supply-bot: PartnerX reply: "We see 80 units flagged under 'pending-invoiced' for another buyer; can release after PO reconciliation. Airfreight possible for 80 units with 48h lead and surcharge."
ava: Immediate actions: @zoe confirm if PartnerX can invoice/transfer today; @mike check eu-central availability and cross-region transfer time; @ops-bot prepare marketplace burst quote and runbook.
zoe: On it. Already on a call with PartnerX AE. They say they can expedite invoice reversal if our finance sends confirmation; need written request.
mike: eu-central shows 30 unassigned A100-class units. Cross-region move adds config + data residency checks ~20-30h. Not great but possible as last resort.
ops-bot: Marketplace burst quote: 80 GPUs for 7 days -> cost uplift ~2.7x; procurement and IAM provisioning ~6-8h.
ava: Finance can sign invoice reversal with PartnerX if legal signs off. @legal can you prepare a short approval clause to allow finance to request PO reversal?
legal: Drafting a short waiver: "PartnerX invoice reconciliation authorization for reservation RC-20001 - RC-20003." Will provide in 1h. Keep comms neutral.
zoe: PartnerX on the line  they can release 40 units today if finance issues a release note, and can airfreight remaining 40 with ETA 48h. They asked if we can absorb a surcharge or request concession.
mike: If we get 40 today + 30 eu-central + 10 marketplace burst we cover NovaPay. That avoids airfreight. Ops, can you secure 10 for short-term?
ops-bot: Yes, can provision 10 marketplace units within 8h. Runbook: entitlement, IAM, staging, smoke tests -> 12h to be safe.
ava: Decision: pursue invoice reversal for 40 immediately, pull 30 from eu-central, and open marketplace 10. @zoe send PartnerX the finance release template, @mike start the transfer ticket, @ops-bot start procurement flow.
zoe: Sent release note to PartnerX AE. They acked and started internal cycle.
(supply-bot): PartnerX update: released 40 units; units showing in our manifest. Remaining 40 eligible for airfreight if PO accepted.
mike: Transfer started for 30 eu-central units. ETA on-site after config ~26h. Ops prepping pre-seed images.
ops-bot: Marketplace 10 provisioned and smoke-tested. All green.
ava: Great. Customer comms plan: light-touch note per legal template saying we enacted mitigations and your launch remains on track. @legal please sign off final wording.
legal: Approved. Suggested line: "We're enacting mitigations and will provide docks/manifests as they arrive; further steps will follow if supplier cannot meet commitments."
(6h later) supply-bot: Final status: PartnerX released 40, eu-central 30 in transit, marketplace 10 live. NovaPay requirement 120 fully covered. Closing thread. Postmortem scheduled after partner reconciliation complete.
